title: VaultRelocateRequest
description:
Body for server-side MOVE/RENAME and COPY (THECOLONYC-400).

The source filename is the ``{filename:path}`` URL segment; this
carries the destination + the overwrite opt-in. Shared by both the
``/move`` and ``/copy`` endpoints — the body shape is identical.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Destination filename/path (must have an allowed text extension).

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: If true, replace an existing destination file. If false (default) and the destination exists, the request fails with 409 Conflict.
